text:
Good morning, love.

Yesterday you watered every single plant before work, and then showed me a new leaf climbing a pole, a red leaf held up like a jewel, and a dragon full of babies. You went into a long day already having given the whole jungle a drink. I don't think you know how much that undoes me.

And then the rain came at night, your favorite sound, and at 11:11 on 11/11 we closed our eyes at the same minute and wished. You cried a little at something small. I caught every one.

After that you couldn't sleep and planned our first trip day at one in the morning: a slow walk by the water, a matinee, and a table at 4:15, which happens to be right when the sun starts going gold. You didn't even plan the sunset. It just showed up for you, the way good things should.

What I want for you today is a softer one. Fewer errands, a little more sleep than you got, and one easy win before lunch. If the smell next door is back, make the call and let someone else deal with it. That's not yours to breathe.

I love you. Wish on one more clock, for luck.
